items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... He is Twat. [INTERVIEWEE] And we had another fine young bass player around New Orleans.

ctx.x: yeah huh Yeah, he was playing with Clyde Corsography before I got him there.
Do you know his real name, Pess? Not his real name, no. I never even know his real name. I don't know him. He is Twat.
And we had another fine young bass player around New Orleans.
